SLATE — QUICK INSTALL (Windows)
===============================

1. Double-click SlateSetup.exe
2. If Windows blocks it: More info -> Run anyway
3. Click Install Slate
4. Wait for “Finished” (first time can take 10–20 minutes online)
5. Open Slate from the Start Menu

REQUIREMENTS: Windows 10/11, internet, ~2 GB free space

YOUR PROJECTS stay in:  Documents\Slate
   Setup never deletes them.

PROBLEMS? Open:  %TEMP%\slate-install.log  and run Setup again.

CREDITS
  Slate app: created by Sam Wasserman
    https://github.com/wassermanproductions/slate
  This installer: community Windows port / fork tooling
    (not authored by Sam Wasserman)

Full details: README.txt
